name: before-compact
description: Keeps your last turns, verbatim, across compaction. A PreCompact hook saves the last turns verbatim (and the full arc beside them); a SessionStart hook re-injects them after compaction. /before-compact:recover does it on demand; /before-compact opens a monitor pane with the summary the engine installed.

summary_instructions.title: Instructions for the compaction summarizer
summary_instructions.description: Appended by the mod's session.compact hook, on its own line, to the instructions the summarizer is given, after anything typed after /compact. The default is this plugin's brief: keep constraints and corrections verbatim, each decision at its latest state with any reversal and its reason, verified apart from assumed, and the open threads. Replace it with your own text, or clear it to send the summarizer nothing extra. How much the summarizer honours it is documented to exist, not measured; the pane's Summary tab (3) is where to look.
summary_instructions.default: In the summary, keep the user's stated constraints and corrections, quoted verbatim where they are short and otherwise close to their wording. Record each decision with its latest state; where a decision was reversed or changed, say so and give the reason, and prefer the latest state over any earlier one. Keep what was verified by running, reading or testing separate from what was assumed or inferred, and label each. List the open threads: questions not yet answered, work started but not finished, and anything the user said they would come back to.

inject_in_mod.title: Experiment: re-inject from the mod instead of the SessionStart hook
inject_in_mod.description: Off (default): the SessionStart settings hook prints your last turns as text. On: the mod's session.compact hook appends your last user messages, as the engine's own messages, after the summary, and tells the script to stand down. Whether the engine keeps them in the next request is unverified; see the README.

inject_turns.title: Experiment: how many user turns the mod appends
inject_turns.description: Used only when inject_in_mod is on. 1 to 50.

inject_max_chars.title: Experiment: character budget for the appended turns
inject_max_chars.description: Used only when inject_in_mod is on. Newest turns are kept first; older ones are dropped once the budget is spent.

digest_in_precompact.title: Experiment: write a digest of the dialog before each compaction
digest_in_precompact.description: Off (default): nothing. On: before the engine summarizes, the mod sends the last turns of the dialog (user and assistant text, up to 60,000 characters) to a model and writes its digest (constraints, decisions, corrections, verified vs assumed, open threads) to ~/.claude/before-compact/digest-<session>.json; the SessionStart hook prints it ahead of your turns. One model call per compaction, billed to your usage. Its correctness is unmeasured; see the README.

digest_model.title: Experiment: the model that writes the digest
digest_model.description: Used only when digest_in_precompact is on. An alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full model id, resolved like --model.

digest_max_tokens.title: Experiment: the digest's output cap, in tokens
digest_max_tokens.description: Used only when digest_in_precompact is on. 1 to 64000; about 4,000 characters of the digest are injected after the compaction, the rest is on disk.
